summary: Gravel pull-off at the start, bush on the west side, homes across a wide road.
reasons: Gravel pull-off with vehicles, off the lane

best_section.where: West side at the start, by the gravel pull-off where vehicles are parked

drivers.seclusion: Dense bush behind; nearest house is across a wide road, over 40 m away; mapped buildings on the section's side are sheds.
drivers.access_and_room: Bare gravel pull-off meets the road edge with a vehicle on it; further south a grassy verge about 5 m wide runs beside the lane.
drivers.traffic: Wide two-lane through road, but the van stands clear of the lane.
drivers.convention: Vehicles parked on the pull-off in the imagery; no signs mapped.

flags: Low-lying: 5 to 12 m, Cubberla Creek 16 m away
Mapped gate 95 m south has a way round it
sun_shade: Open to the sky at the pull-off; bush to the west gives afternoon shade.
cannot_judge: Whether the gravel area is formally a parking bay
